title: Mood Media Alternatives: A 2026 Operator's Guide | Entuned
meta_description: A retail operator's guide to Mood Media alternatives in 2026. Who the players are, what they cost, and the questions that filter them down to a shortlist.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Mood Media in 2026?
faq.a: The 2026 shortlist splits into three buckets. Cheaper catalog SaaS (Soundtrack Your Brand at roughly $35 to $50 per location per month, Cloud Cover Music at $10 to $25). Legacy broadcast (SiriusXM for Business at $30 to $80). A small number of generative vendors (QSIC in Australia and New Zealand, Entuned in the US for multi-location lifestyle retail). Each bucket has a different tradeoff on price, contract structure, targeting, and performance reporting.

faq.q: Why are operators leaving Mood Media?
faq.a: Five reasons come up repeatedly. Long multi-year contracts with termination penalties. No performance reporting beyond play logs and schedule adherence. Targeting limited to genre and mood channels, with no connection to the retailer's specific customer. Catalog fatigue because staff and regulars hear every track in rotation dozens of times a month. Bundled pricing that hides the real per-location cost until finance goes looking for it.

faq.q: How do the alternatives actually compare on price?
faq.a: Cloud Cover Music is the cheapest, roughly $10 to $25 per location per month. Soundtrack Your Brand runs $35 to $50 with licensing included. SiriusXM for Business negotiates enterprise pricing in the $30 to $80 range. Mood Media and legacy providers are typically bundled with hardware and support, which makes direct comparison difficult. Entuned runs a free pilot first.

faq.q: What questions should I ask before signing with any vendor?
faq.a: Five questions separate the vendors who can deliver measurable value from the ones who cannot. What do you report on quarterly? What is your termination clause, in writing? Is the music licensed or original, and who owns the PRO liability? How does my customer data shape what plays? Can you show me a before-and-after from a comparable retailer with specific metrics on dwell, conversion, and basket?

faq.q: What does switching cost a multi-location retailer?
faq.a: Two costs. First, the early termination penalty in the current contract, which can run into the tens of thousands depending on locations and remaining term. Second, the operational cost of running a parallel setup during transition. Both are knowable before you make the decision. Pull the contract and read the termination clause before you take the first sales call with an alternative.
